title: Watch You Serpentine
author: Ramya Rajan
problems: Row 1 "circle left 2 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
Row 2 "mad robins ½ around, larks in front with partner to shadow 1" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 3 "mad robins ½ around, robins in front with shadow 1 to shadow 2" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 4 "mad robins ½ around, larks in front with shadow 2" can't start from where the dancers are: A mad robin needs two dancers on each side line, one above the other.
Row 5 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.
